title: Ye jawab sahi hai. Aur phir bhi ghalat.
caption:
2¹⁰ = 1024. Hisaab bilkul theek hai, jawab phir bhi ghalat. Scientific notation ka matlab hai 1 se 10 ke darmiyan ek number, aur 10 ki power. Is liye 1.024 × 10³.

Ye sawal NET 2023 mein aaya tha.
